## Objective
- Build a complete, playable football game with realistic gameplay, full teams and rosters, and graphics for all devices.

## Requirements
- User requested: “A 3d football 🏈 game that is the best out there with realistic real gameplay for gridiron masterpiece that pays it should be full rosters and full list of teams with all-real graphics for all devices”.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser game with canvas-rendered football gameplay, all 32 NFL team names, and responsive desktop/mobile layouts.
- Used fictional player names and ratings; this is an arcade-style 2D canvas game, not a fully realistic 3D game or licensed-real-graphics experience.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with a game menu, team matchup selection, a simulated field, player movement, passing, tackling, scoring, quarters, and win/lose flow.
- Added desktop keyboard controls and mobile touch controls.
- Added all 32 NFL team names and a fictional 11-player starting roster.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Opened the app in Playwright and inspected screenshots at `screenshots/menu.jpg` and `screenshots/game.jpg`.

### Active
- Finish and verify mobile team selection and game control updates made after the screenshot checks.
- Review final changes and summarize the implementation and its limitations for the user.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reopen or reload `http://localhost:3002` and verify desktop and mobile layouts, including mobile team selection and touch controls.
2. Check for gameplay or console errors; the earlier only observed console error was a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).
3. Report honestly that this is a playable arcade-style prototype, not a realistic 3D licensed football game.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation, styling, team/roster data, and gameplay logic.
- `screenshots/menu.jpg`: Earlier menu screenshot.
- `screenshots/game.jpg`: Earlier gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Recent edits added mobile team selectors (`#homeMobile`, `#awayMobile`) synchronized with desktop selectors and made mobile controls responsive to viewport width; these edits have not yet been reverified.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable football game with realistic gameplay, full teams and rosters, and graphics that work across devices.

## Requirements
- User requested: “A 3d football 🏈 game that is the best out there with realistic real gameplay for gridiron masterpiece that pays it should be full rosters and full list of teams with all-real graphics for all devices”.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone, responsive browser arcade prototype with canvas-rendered gameplay rather than a full 3D simulation.
- Included all 32 NFL team names and a fictional 11-player roster; real player names, licensed graphics, and complete real rosters are not included.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented `index.html` with team selection, football field, 11-vs-11 play, movement, passing, tackling, scoring, quarters, and game-over flow.
- Added desktop keyboard controls and mobile touch controls and team selectors.

- Updated clock display to use ceiling-rounded seconds.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Captured Chromium screenshots of the menu and gameplay at mobile and desktop viewport sizes.

### Active
- Review final changes and summarize the prototype and its limitations for the user.

- (none)

1. Optionally inspect `index.html` once more for gameplay issues; automated checks covered syntax and screenshots, but not a full interactive playthrough.
2. Summarize the implementation and clearly state it is an arcade-style 2D prototype, not a realistic 3D licensed football game.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation, styling, team data, and gameplay logic.
- `screenshots/menu.jpg`: Earlier menu capture.
- `screenshots/game.jpg`: Earlier gameplay capture.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status` showed `index.html` and other project files as untracked.
